## You will be able to

- Understand the AI landscape and what it means for the business model
- Ask the right oversight questions on AI strategy and risk
- Understand regulatory exposure and investment logic

## Demos

| # | Demo | Module | Min | Shows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `01_cost_curve_and_capability.py` | 1 | 8 | what one million customer questions cost across three model classes and three designs — the number that reshapes a business case |
| 2 | `02_portfolio_and_funding.py` | 2+4 | 10 | the client's use cases ranked into quick wins and bets with phase budgets, from the uniAIverse strategy engine, plus the readiness score that limits the pace |
| 3 | `03_risk_oversight_dashboard.py` | 3 | 10 | the AI inventory classified by risk tier with control coverage, from the real governance engine — the page a board should see each quarter |

## Run of show
**One week before:** `python demos/run_all.py` on the laptop you will present from — it must print `ALL DEMOS OK`. Swap `demos/data/` for the client's own examples where you can. Print `exercises.md` per table and the handout per person.
**In the room:** each demo is one command from this folder: `python demos/NN_name.py`. No internet or API key needed. Each ends with a *Say it* line — your closing sentence.
**Live mode:** set `LLM_PROVIDER` and a key in the repo `.env`; demos that benefit then call a real model.
**In the browser:** every demo also runs from the `/demos` page (section *Course labs*) — useful for sales calls and the website.
